BUNKER EVOLVED 1.0 — PUBLICATION KIT

The released firmware is the exact owner-tested build: FM-1_7100002.
Its internal label remains BE 1.0-RC2. Existing users need no reflash.

Website, English guide, installer and recovery:
https://bunker-evolved.sugarypixie10.chatgpt.site
English film:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NJ5UFi62s_0
Release 1.0:
https://github.com/kidbee85-beep/bunker-evolved/releases/tag/v1.0.0

The owner confirmed Bunker -> original -> Bunker -> original, with working
audio and controls, on 17 October 2026. See hardware-acceptance.md and
test-status.txt for the precise scope. Power-loss recovery is not established.

Use Bunker-Evolved-Source.zip for the complete corresponding source, build
instructions, tests and retained licenses. GitHub's automatically generated
source archive is not a substitute: the repository's Code tab is not yet a
full source checkout. Verify the supplied files against SHA256SUMS.txt.

The film is 4:23, HD H.264/AAC, with calm English AI narration and actual
firmware-rendered screens/audio. SRT/VTT captions have approximate sentence
alignment. Use the updated YouTube-Description.txt to accompany the film.
The film itself has not been replaced because the tested instrument is unchanged.

Installation directly from stock uses the supported MIDI update protocol.
AMB-1 is not a prerequisite. V15 is the documented installer baseline.
Read the recovery guide, back up data and do not interrupt power while writing.

Software: GPL-3.0-only with retained component notices.
Film/narration: prepared for the Kid Bunka Bunker Evolved project, separately
from the software license. See Production-Notes.txt for provenance.
